identificationCriteria: Medico-pedagogical commissions identify children with speech disorders and refer them on
They are special teachers with psychologists, speech therapists and defectologists
The same commissions transfer a child from one specialized institution to another
Parents are not required to be consulted at any point in that process
No explicit definition of special education needs has been found, so no threshold is set

sources.label: UNESCO PEER, Turkmenistan inclusion profile — early identification, screening and assessment: the medico-pedagogical commissions, their composition, and the absence of an explicit definition of special education needs

identificationCriteria: The 2008 National Report on the Development of Special Education sets out the categories
They are mental, physical, sight or multiple handicaps and learning or behavioural problems
Also a specific affection such as ADHD, autism or Down syndrome; no speech or language entry
PEER records no inclusive education law, and therefore no official definition in the country
The country has very limited capacity for early detection of disabilities

sources.label: UNESCO PEER, Suriname inclusion profile — the special education needs categories of the 2008 National Report on the Development of Special Education, and the absence of an inclusive education law

identificationCriteria: No legislation or policy fixes a definition of inclusive education or special educational needs
Disability Act No. 007/PR/2007 gives a right to education and training, and sets no criterion
Nothing formally supervises inclusive education beyond isolated and fragmented initiatives
So there is no instrument in which an identification criterion could sit, and none is applied

sources.label: UNESCO PEER, Chad inclusion profile — no legislation or policy fixing a definition of inclusive education or special educational needs, and no formal supervision of inclusive education

identificationCriteria: Vatican City State runs no school system, so no body inside it identifies a language disorder
Its children attend legally recognized schools under various other States' legislation
One minor seminary stands on the territory, open to non-residents and non-citizens

sources.label: Holy See, second periodic report to the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child, CRC/C/VAT/2 (22 October 2012), section IV on Vatican City State, para. 114 — schooling of children resident in the State
